# Raid EN06 Guardian Solo: New Beginner Guide 2026

![Raid EN06 Guardian Solo: New Beginner Guide 2026](/uploads/654_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update 03/11/2026] Added common problems list

[Update 03/07/2026] Bloodstained as an alternative to Raging on the plasma rifle

In this article we will describe a build and method to defeat the EN-06 Guardian alone in the 1st stage of the RAID. This method does not require any legendary perks or high-end equipment. Therefore it can also be done under level 100. Nevertheless, you need some plans, legendary mods and you should have played the settlers' main quest up to the Chinese camouflage armor. 

The advanced 10 sec guide can be found here.

| ![](/uploads/collab-nukaknights-angryturtle-150px.png) | This article was created in collaboration with **Angry Turtle [Youtube]**. Fallout 76 Raid Guardian EN06 Solo: New Faster Beginner Guide Q2 2026 | 

## Requirements

- from level 50-60 (if all required perks have been selected)
- Chinese camouflage armor
- Plasma rifle with flamethrower mod and short-range scope
- Agressotron head
- Legendary Mods:
 - 1x Raging or 1x Bloodstained
 - 1x quick
 - 1x quick
 - 1x quadruple
 - 1x cripple

## Perk cards

**Legendary perks are not needed**, if you have "Aftermath" and want to use it, it will improve the build.

**Strength [8]**

| Easy target 3* | *75% more damage against crippled enemies* | 
| Bullet hail 3* | *9% damage per 30 units of ammunition consumed. Max. 10 stacks. That's a 90% bonus after 300 shots. 180% when 20 stacks are full.* | 
| Loading 2* | *You keep half of your bullet stacks when reloading. +1% reload speed per stack. This way you can reach the limit of 20.* | more quickly 

**Perception [15]**

| Number Eater 3* |  *2% more damage per AP cost point. That's +28% on the Plasma Rifle, +60% on the Aggressotron Head.* | 
| Tormentor 2* | +20% damage for each crippled body part of your target. Since the shield is crippled here, we get a 20% bonus. | 
| Tank Killer 2* |  *Your ranged weapons ignore 40% armor.* | 
| Smart Shooter 3* | *Deal +25% damage to weak points when aiming a scoped weapon.* | 
| Middleman 3* | *You deal +75% ranged damage when targeting the torso.* | 
| Cover on 2* | *+10% damage for each attack your target has. Here it is +10% from crippling the shield.* | 

**Stamina [4]**

| Tough 3* | *45% reduced damage from explosions. Not absolutely necessary as we won't be harmed here.* | 
| Strengthened genes 1* | *Ensures we keep our mutations even when we use Rad Away.* | 

**Charisma [2]**

| Meat tenderizer 2* | *Each attack increases damage to your target. For each hit, the damage to an enemy increases by 0.1%, with 1000 hits the maximum of 100% is reached.* | 

**Intelligence [7]**

| Nerd Rage 2* | *When your health is low, damage and AP regeneration increases. Between 80% and 5% health, damage and AP regeneration scale, the lower the higher. 20% TP = 40% damage bonus + 15% AP regeneration 5% TP = 80% damage bonus + 30% AP regeneration* | 
| Science! 2* | *Increases energy damage based on your INT. Regardless of the type of weapon. If you only play ballistic weapons, you don't need this perk. ![](/uploads/nukaknights-science-perks-int-scaling-graph.png)* | 
| Weaponsmith 3* | *Guns break 50% slower.* | 

**Agility [15]**

High mobility is important here as it greatly improves stealth ability and is the basis for this build.
